mathematical_solution: Flag 1 has 3 black unit squares out of 8, fraction 3/8. Flag 2 has 12 of its 20 equal cells black, fraction 3/5. Flag 3 consists of a black triangle of base 2 and height 1 plus a black unit rectangle, within a 3-by-1 flag: fraction (1+1)/3=2/3. Flag 4 has three complete black rows out of five equal rows, fraction 3/5. In flag 5 the three black rectangles have areas 2,1,1 and the two white rectangles have areas 2,2, so black fraction is 4/8=1/2. Exactly flags 2 and 4 qualify, uniquely Two (C). All region dimensions, black/white fill and existing boundaries remain unchanged.
